#include <algorithm>
#include <concepts>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <ranges>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace demo {

template <typename T>
concept Numeric = std::integral<T> || std::floating_point<T>;

template <Numeric T>
constexpr T square(T x) noexcept { return x * x; }

class robot {
public:
    explicit robot(std::string name) : name_{std::move(name)} {}
    virtual ~robot() = default;
    [[nodiscard]] const std::string& name() const& { return name_; }
    auto operator<=>(const robot&) const = default;
    static inline int count = 0;
private:
    std::string name_;
};

struct point { int x{}, y{}; };

enum class dir : unsigned char { north, east, south, west };

inline std::optional<int> parse(std::string_view sv) {
    if (sv.empty()) return std::nullopt;
    int v = 0;
    for (char c : sv) { if (c < '0' || c > '9') return {}; v = v * 10 + (c - '0'); }
    return v;
}

template <typename... Args>
auto sum(Args... args) { return (args + ...); }

inline void demo_fn() {
    std::vector<int> v{3, 1, 2};
    std::ranges::sort(v);
    auto evens = v | std::views::filter([](int i) { return i % 2 == 0; });
    for (auto&& e : evens) { (void)e; }
    auto p = std::make_unique<robot>("r2");
    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<point>> m;
    m["a"].push_back({.x = 1, .y = 2});
    auto [a, b] = std::pair{1, 2};
    (void)a; (void)b;
    auto lam = [&, x = 1]<typename T>(T t) mutable -> T { return t + x; };
    (void)lam(1);
    if (auto r = parse("12"); r && *r > 0) {}
    using namespace std::literals;
    auto s = "abc"s;
    (void)s;
}

}  // namespace demo
